scenes.a: You are carrying an unfinished story into this morning, afraid you will fail.
The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
Lord, we release every concern into Your capable hands this morning.
What we cannot complete, You are already working out for our good.
Do not abandon the work You have begun in our lives, but finish it according to Your divine purpose.
Subscribe to The Morning Altar to begin every sunrise in prayer.
